response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg), g AS (SELECT mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY mix), s AS (SELECT mix, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.mix, s.cnt, s.share, s.share - av.avg_share AS above_avg FROM s CROSS JOIN av WHERE s.share > av.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC
